games.name: DON'T BLINK
games.desc:
👁️ DON’T BLINK is a 1vAll or 2vAll survival horror game inspired by Doctor Who, where survivors must escape deadly Angels and survive until the round timer ends.

As a survivor, you MUST control your blinks, keep your eyes on the Angels, and never look away at the wrong time. Every blink gives them a chance to move closer. Survive the round before they reach you.

As an Angel, you must wipe out all the survivors before the timer runs out.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: THIS GAME IS NOT FOR SALE. BEWARE OF PEOPLE IMPERSONATING ME OR PRETENDING TO OWN THE GAME.

games.name: [🐟] Fisch
games.desc:
🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down [LMB] to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click [LMB] to pull the bar white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!

games.name: Benidorm Fun Town Tycoon
games.desc:
🌴 Welcome to Benidorm — the most fun city in the world! ☀️

The official Benidorm Fun Town Tycoon is here! The Mayor needs YOU — the world's most famous architect — to grow a magical skyscraper from an enchanted seed. 🌊 Beach & Coast — sunbathe and build sandcastles
🤿 Diving — snorkel or become a mermaid

🏛️ Old Town — discover the city's history

games.name: BloxyWare's Disasters
games.desc:
🔥 Welcome to BloxyWare's Disasters! 🔥
Run, fight, and outlast the most chaotic and epic disasters ever! Use everything to your advantage, earn points, and do whatever it takes to survive. Good luck, and don't die!

🦆 Join the "BloxyWare" group to receive a FREE Epic Duck Gear in-game! 🦆

⚔️ GEAR UP:
Don't just stand there! Spend your hard-earned points to buy powerful items:
• 🏹 Weapons: Melee, Ranged, and Explosives to fight back against NPC disasters!
• 🛡️ Utility: Speed Coils, Healing Items, and tools to outsmart death.
• 🍔 Fun Items: Burgers, Drinks, Ducks, and more to survive with style.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:
• 🌪️ Pure Chaos: Random disasters mixed with unpredictable round modifiers!
• 🗳️ Map Voting: You and the server decide where the next chaos strikes.
• 😈 Be the Disaster: Use Robux to force specific disasters and modifiers.
• 🥇 Milestones: Earn unique badges for your survival... and your deaths too!

👍 Leave a Like and Favorite if you enjoy the game! It helps a lot!

games.name: Ashwood: SURVIVAL
games.desc:
Even ashes can burn again…

It burned in the fire. The radiation brought it back.
Now it hates the light that reminds it of death.

Team up. Fight back. It only makes IT angrier.
So come prepared — there’s always someone selling hope.

⸻

👀 Ashwood is a survival game focused on PvE, with optional PvP.
Survive the night, buy weapons, fight IT — or other players.

⚠️ This game is in Early Access / Active Development.
You may encounter bugs, glitches, and unfinished content.

👍 Thanks for your support — it means a lot to us. We appreciate your understanding!

⸻
